points.text: M1: any two of: (hexagonal ring) planar / (trigonal) planar; $120^\circ$; $\text{sp}^2$ hybridised
M2: all three of: (hexagonal ring) planar / (trigonal) planar; $120^\circ$; $\text{sp}^2$ hybridised
M3: p orbitals overlap sideways / laterally (with each other above and below the ring) forming $\pi$ bonds
M4: $\sigma$ bonds form when $\text{sp}^2$ / hybridised orbitals overlap end-on-end / head on
($\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3$ group) directs to 2-, 4- (and 6-) positions AND due to being an electron donating group
M1: curly arrow from inside / touching the hexagon to $(\text{CH}_2)$ group / $\text{C}^+$ charge
M3: curly arrow from $\text{C-H}$ bond into / onto the ring AND formation / loss of $\text{H}^+$
